title: MKM Myeongri AI interpretation envelope v1 (B-track, human review)
description: Structured LLM narrative wrapper around deterministic pipeline outputs. Not a trading or medical signal; not A-track.

mkm_advanced_insight.description: Hypothesis-only narrative; must remain consistent with [HYPO] tier.

confidence_score.description: Self-rated coherence of interpretation vs inputs; not forecast probability.

method_id.description: Optional: similarity/window definition id for audit replay.

rag_sources_used.description: Repo-relative paths or URIs of chunks injected into context.

deterministic_input_sha256.description: Optional SHA256 of canonical JSON fed to the model.

prohibition_ack.description: Fixed acknowledgement that output is not live trading, medical, or doctrinal finality.
